news.headline: Carlson rebounded well after missing a potential game-winning 62-yard kick wide right to end regulation in the team's 31
news.detail: Carlson rebounded well after missing a potential game-winning 62-yard kick wide right to end regulation in the team's 31-30 overtime loss to the Lions in Week 1. The kicker nailed a chip-shot 23-yard field goal in the second quarter before converting a 47-yard try as time expired in the first half.
